title: VeriWorld: A Verifiable Visual SWE-Bench for Spatial Reasoning in 3D Environments
abstract: arXiv:2611.30226v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for spatial tasks such as navigation and manipulation, where they must infer geometry and object relationships from visual input in order to act correctly. Existing benchmarks usually test perception and reasoning in isolation, making it hard to tell whether failures come from visual understanding, downstream reasoning, or the bridge between them. We introduce VeriWorld, a benchmark for spatial reasoning in interactive 3D environments with executable actions and deterministic verification. For task families where all three channels are well-defined, we evaluate matched visual, structured, and combined input conditions on the same instance, environment, and verifier; families without a clean visual/structured/combined split are reported separately. translated_title: VeriWorld：一个面向3D环境空间推理的可验证视觉SWE-Bench
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）越来越多地被用于导航和操作等空间任务，在这些任务中，模型必须从视觉输入中推断几何信息和物体关系才能正确行动。现有基准通常将感知和推理分开测试，导致难以判断失败究竟源于视觉理解、下游推理，还是两者之间的衔接。我们提出VeriWorld，这是一个针对交互式3D环境空间推理的基准，具备可执行动作和确定性验证机制。对于三种输入通道（视觉、结构化、组合）均有明确定义的任务族，我们在相同的实例、环境和验证器上评估相互匹配的视觉、结构化和组合输入条件；不具备清晰视觉/结构化/组合划分的任务族则单独报告。这一设计支持对感知、推理及其相互作用的受控比较。利用这一评估框架，我们揭示了两个诊断性发现（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出VeriWorld，一个具有可执行动作和确定性验证的交互式3D环境空间推理基准，通过在相同实例、环境和验证器上评估匹配的视觉、结构化和组合输入条件，实现了对感知、推理及其相互作用的受控对比诊断，从而精确定位VLM失败的来源环节。
en_tdlr: VeriWorld is a benchmark for spatial reasoning in interactive 3D environments with executable actions and deterministic verification, enabling controlled comparisons of perception, reasoning, and their interaction by evaluating matched visual, structured, and combined input conditions on identical instances.
